text:
elaine: Quick check — spotted a broken link in the runtime/batching guide that makes the canary rollout note 404. can someone own a tiny fix? link: https://redwood.dev/docs/runtime/batching#canary
matt: thanks for flagging, can you paste the failing URL or screenshot? I can take a quick look if you need a hand.
docs-bot: automated link-scan: /docs/runtime/batching#canary returned 404 on crawl run at 2024-11-02.
elaine: pasted the snippet from the page: `See canary details at /runtime/batching#canary` — looks like the anchor was renamed when rollouts docs moved.
jordana: I maintain the runtime docs — I can open a small PR to update the anchor and add a redirect rule. will also add a one-line note about the rollout thresholds while I'm in there. who can CR?
ashok: I can review the PR. please add a short changelog line in the PR body so QA knows it's doc-only. also, if you're touching redirects, ping infra so the shortlink TTL gets cleared.
elaine: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4123 — replaces the old anchor with `/runtime/rollouts#canary` and adds a redirect entry. @ashok pinged for review :thumbsup:
matt: looked quick — PR is tiny, tests are docs CI only. lgtm from my side once CI passes. if no other objections, merge after checks ✅
jordana: thanks all — merging after CI. will follow up with infra about the shortlink TTL and update the handbook note so onboarding doesn't reference the old anchor. :sparkles:
